# ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup (Resource)

Use this resource to create a Point In Time (PIT) backup of an Azure key. Each time the trigger value changes, one new backup is created in CipherTrust Manager. Destroying this resource does not delete the backup, it remains in CipherTrust Manager and can be used to restore the key with the restore_key block of ciphertrust_azure_key. Only create one ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup resource per key. To take another backup of the same key, change the trigger value of the existing resource. This resource cannot be imported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pre-requisites for a PIT backup - an Azure key managed by CipherTrust Manager.
# See the ciphertrust_azure_key resource for how to create the connection,
# vault and key.
#
# Notes
# - Each time the trigger value changes, the resource is replaced and one new
#   backup is created.
# - Destroying the resource does not delete the backup. It remains in
#   CipherTrust Manager and can be used to restore the key.
# - Use one ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup resource per key. To take another
#   backup of the same key, change the trigger value.
# - Import is not supported.

# Create a PIT backup of a key
resource "ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup" "backup" {
  key_id  = ciphertrust_azure_key.rsa_key.id
  trigger = "initial"
  # Optional
  name        = "rsa-key-backup"
  description = "Backup taken before the upgrade"
}

# Take another backup of the same key by changing the trigger
# resource "ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup" "backup" {
#   key_id  = ciphertrust_azure_key.rsa_key.id
#   trigger = "after-upgrade"
# }

# Restore the key into another vault from the backup
resource "ciphertrust_azure_key" "restored_key" {
  vault_id = ciphertrust_azure_vault.other_vault.id
  restore_key = {
    key_id    = ciphertrust_azure_key.rsa_key.id
    backup_id = ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup.backup.id
  }
}

output "backup_id" {
  value = ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup.backup.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_id` (String) (Immutable) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the Azure key to back up.
- `trigger` (String) Arbitrary user-supplied value that controls when a backup is taken. Changing this value replaces the resource, which creates one additional backup.

### Optional

- `description` (String) (Immutable) Description for the backup.
- `name` (String) (Immutable) Name for the backup.

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) CipherTrust Manager account of the backup.
- `backup` (String) Opaque identifier of the backup data held by CipherTrust Manager.
- `cloud_name` (String) Azure cloud of the key vault.
- `created_at` (String) Date and time the backup was created in CipherTrust Manager.
- `gone` (Boolean) Whether the backed up key no longer exists in Azure.
- `id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the PIT backup. Use it as restore_key.backup_id.
- `key_name` (String) Name of the backed up key.
- `key_vault` (String) Key vault of the backed up key in the form <vault name>::<subscription ID>.
- `region` (String) Azure region of the key vault.
- `subscription_id` (String) Azure subscription ID of the key vault.
- `subscription_name` (String) Azure subscription name of the key vault.
- `tenant` (String) Azure tenant ID of the key.
- `type` (String) Type of the backup.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time the backup was last updated in CipherTrust Manager.
- `uri` (String) CipherTrust Manager URI of the backup.
- `vault_name` (String) Name of the Azure key vault.
